## Summary

Closes #110.

Adds command-line overrides for LLM provider/model/runtime parameters, moves the analyst volatility-regime thresholds behind config, and supports prompt template overrides through config or a prompt directory.

## Changes

- Adds `replicate.py` LLM override flags for provider, model, temperature, max tokens, timeout, base URL, API key env, audit log, max retries, retry backoff, and prompt directory.
- Adds `agents.llm.volatility_regime` defaults to `config.yaml`.
- Allows `LLMAnalyst` and `LLMRiskManager` to receive configured prompts.
- Allows `LLMAnalyst` to receive configured volatility-regime thresholds.
- Adds tests for CLI help/override plumbing and config-driven volatility-regime classification.

## Validation

- [x] `cd replication && python replicate.py --help`
- [x] `cd replication && python -m pytest tests/test_agents_llm.py tests/test_replication.py -q`
- [x] `cd replication && python -m compileall -q replicate.py src/agenticaita/agents_llm.py`

## Scope

No sweep support and no live OpenRouter smoke path are included; those remain #108 and #109.
